items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: Because the screen of phase four was refined first, and therefore the level of Keter was at once concealed. But the level of Malchut emerged through the ascent of Malchut to the place of Keter, and therefore she departs last. (Chapter 6, Item 14)
